newsitem.title: UK: Lloyd's details second capacity auction result.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's details second capacity auction result.

text.p: Lloyd's of London on Thursday announced the results of the second auction of syndicate capacity for the 1998 underwriting year.
A total of 144 million stg of market capacity involving 105 syndicates underwriting this year was successfully auctioned at a total value of 10 million stg.
Subscription offers (offers to buy) totalled 513 million stg and tenders (offers to sell) totalled 313 million stg during the auction held 22 - 23 July.
The auction - which this year uses a fully electronic system - is the second in a series of eight being held from July to September.
The next auction will be held August 5-6.
